negative_findings.description: No Serbian-language (sr) corporate communications channel was located for any Kosovo commercial bank in this cell. Serbian-language queries ('imenovanje direktor', 'saopštenje') returned only Slovenian/Serbian group-level NLB material and Wikipedia, not a sr version of any Kosovo bank site.
negative_findings.result_summary: sr-language own-channel coverage for Kosovo banks appears absent or not indexed; NLB Group (Ljubljana) is the only path to sr/sl-adjacent disclosures about a Kosovo subsidiary.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The run scope mandates sr coverage; if Kosovo banks genuinely publish only in sq/en, sr-language monitoring must be redirected to parent groups and Serbian-language media rather than bank sites.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated 'press release' or 'media' section could be confirmed for TEB Sh.A. Kosovo, BPB beyond /news/, Banka Ekonomike, or Ziraat Bank Kosova; announcements appear mixed into general news pages or only on social channels.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only Raiffeisen, ProCredit and BKT Kosova were confirmed to have a structured, separately-addressable announcements section.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design cannot assume a uniform 'press room' per bank; for four of eight banks the crawler must target general news pages, governance roster pages and social channels instead.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom or JSON feed was observed on any of the bank sites examined; all listings appear to be plain HTML pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Machine-readable feeds absent across the cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Every source in this cell requires HTML crawling and diffing, raising fragility and maintenance cost; snapshot-diffing of governance roster pages becomes the most reliable detection mechanism.

negative_findings.description: https://www.procreditbank-kos.com/shq/lajme/ returned HTTP 500 on a single fetch attempt, while individual item URLs under the same path and the /eng/pages/njoftime/ listing were indexed by search.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as transient or path-specific server error, not a dead source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A one-off 500 must not cause the ProCredit newsroom to be dropped from the collection plan; the deterministic liveness pass should retry both sq and eng listing paths.

negative_findings.description: Targeted sq and en searches for a recent Raiffeisen Kosovo CEO change surfaced only an existing CEO and a COO/CIO appointment; no 2025-2026 CEO succession announcement was found on any own channel.
negative_findings.result_summary: No new-CEO event evidenced for Raiffeisen Kosovo in the searched period.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that absence of a press release is common even for large banks — roster-page diffing, not press-release monitoring, must be the primary detection method for this cell.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language monitoring of Kosovo bank leadership/organization news has no confirmed own-channel source; the sr surface for this cell is effectively unmapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sr-language pass against Serbian-language Kosovo media (kossev.info, kosovo-online.com) and NLB Group's sl/sr disclosures, and check whether any bank offers a Serbian site variant (e.g. /srb/ or /sr/ path probing on each of the eight domains).

coverage_gaps.description: Exact news-listing and careers URLs remain unconfirmed for TEB Sh.A., Banka Ekonomike, BPB and NLB Kosovo main site; only homepages or roster pages were verified in search results.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a shallow site crawl (or sitemap.xml / robots.txt fetch) on teb-kos.com, bekonomike.com, bpbbank.com, nlb-kos.com and hr.nlb-kos.com to enumerate the sq/en news and careers paths before configuring collection.

coverage_gaps.description: The Kosovo business registry (ARBK/KBRA, arbk.rks-gov.net) was not searched in this slice; it records statutory directors and authorised representatives and would give a legally authoritative, machine-checkable view of leadership changes at each bank entity.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an ARBK company-search pass per bank legal entity (Sh.a. names) to capture director changes independent of whether the bank publicises them.

coverage_gaps.description: Parent-group regulated disclosure channels were only partly mapped: RBI (Vienna) for Raiffeisen, BNP Paribas/TEB Türkiye (KAP filings) for TEB, Ziraat Bankası (Ankara) for Ziraat and BKT's Turkish owner Çalık were not individually enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Map each bank's parent IR/press channel, including Borsa Istanbul KAP disclosures for TEB and any Turkish-owned entity, since subsidiary CEO appointments are frequently disclosed at parent level first.

coverage_gaps.description: The two highest-yield channels for leadership and hiring signals (LinkedIn and Facebook) are login-walled and ToS-restricted, so automated collection is not permitted.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Budget for analyst-assisted manual review of the eight banks' LinkedIn/Facebook pages, or procure a licensed social-listening feed; do not build scrapers.

brief: Kosovo's commercial banks are private and each maintains its own website, but only Raiffeisen, ProCredit and BKT Kosova run a structured, separately-addressable announcements section; TEB, Banka Ekonomike, BPB and Ziraat mix corporate news into general pages or push it to Facebook/LinkedIn instead. No RSS or machine-readable feed was found anywhere in the cell, so the most reliable detection mechanism is periodic snapshot-diffing of the governance roster pages (bordi menaxhues / bordi i drejtorëve), which change even when no press release is issued, complemented by careers pages and the two dominant sq job boards for hiring and new-division signals. Three pointer layers materially extend coverage: the Kosovo Banking Association's komunikata (which names member-bank CEOs), the BQK regulator feed (which approves and thus dates board and structural changes such as Banka Ekonomike's absorption of the Türkiye İş Bankası Kosovo branch), and the listed parents NLB Group and ProCredit Holding, whose regulated disclosures often announce Kosovo appointments first. The main weakness is language: sq and en coverage is solid, but no Serbian-language own-channel source exists for any of these banks, and the ARBK business registry has not yet been worked.
